title: Basic rules of the programming message
body_md: The destination numbers are handed to Pro-finder with a single programming message. Up to ten destination numbers are possible. In the source, spaces serve display purposes only and must not be used in the message itself.
source_region: Section 2.8, introductory paragraph above the syntax graphic
prev_context: Before this stands the table with the three types of destination number.
next_context: The syntax graphic of the programming message follows on the same page.
change_reason: Extracted from the English source page itself, not translated from the German master, and cross-read against the German page 15: equivalent in substance, including the prohibition of spaces and the limit of ten numbers. The example structure itself is not quoted (BLK-005, BLK-006).
